'''Arden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] servant who attended a royal reception at [[King/Legends|King]] [[Rilvvan K'ntarr]]'s [[Rilvvan K'ntarr's mansion|mansion]] on [[Rydonni Prime]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was to have a tryst with the king's daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]], but Kalieva accidentally met with professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] instead. Sconn later impersonated Arden when Kalieva attempted help the thief gain access to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Rythani Products prototype|prototype]] weapon.<ref name="Easy" />
